title: rocky config
description: Configuration for rocky — `rocky.json`. Project config (./rocky.json) overrides user config (~/.config/rocky/rocky.json) field by field. The `worklog` block is read by the worklog stdio MCP server and the Stop hook (`rocky-todo mcp worklog` / `rocky-todo hook log-turn`); the `todo` block by the daemon. Both live in crates/ — see crates/rocky-todo-core/src/config.rs.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema. Editors use this for autocomplete and validation.

worklog.description: Settings for the worklog_* tools (append-only agent journal), the Stop hook auto-capture, and the /rocky:recall digest.

dir.description: worklog JSONL 저장 디렉터리. Defaults to a per-project path under ~/.config/rocky/worklog/<project-key>. ROCKY_WORKLOG_DIR wins.

autoCapture.description: Stop hook 자동 기록 on/off (기본 true). env ROCKY_WORKLOG_AUTO_CAPTURE 가 우선.

todo.description: Board daemon settings (port / dir / expose / watch / statusline). Shape is owned by crates/rocky-todo-core/src/config.rs.
